name: tv_discover
description: Report which known TradingView API paths are available and their methods

name: tv_ui_state
description: Get current UI state: which panels are open, what buttons are visible/enabled/disabled

name: chart_get_state
description: Get current chart state (symbol, timeframe, chart type, indicators)

name: chart_set_symbol
description: Change the chart symbol

symbol.description: Symbol to set (e.g., BTCUSD, AAPL, ES1!, NYMEX:CL1!)

name: chart_set_timeframe
description: Change the chart timeframe/resolution

name: chart_set_type
description: Change chart type

chart_type.description: Chart type: Bars(0), Candles(1), Line(2), Area(3), Renko(4), Kagi(5), PointAndFigure(6), LineBreak(7), HeikinAshi(8), HollowCandles(9) — pass name or number

name: chart_manage_indicator
description: Add or remove an indicator/study on the chart

indicator.description: Full indicator name (required for add): "Relative Strength Index", "MACD", "Volume", "Moving Average", "Bollinger Bands", "Moving Average Exponential". Short names like RSI/EMA do NOT work. Not needed for remove.

entity_id.description: Entity ID (from chart_get_state). Required for remove.

inputs.description: JSON string of input overrides for the indicator (e.g., '{"length": 20}')

name: chart_get_visible_range
description: Get the visible date range (unix timestamps) and bars range on the chart

name: chart_set_visible_range
description: Zoom the chart to a specific date range (unix timestamps)

from.description: Start of range (unix timestamp in seconds)

to.description: End of range (unix timestamp in seconds)

name: chart_scroll_to_date
description: Jump the chart view to center on a specific date

date.description: ISO date string (e.g., "2024-01-15") or unix timestamp as a string

name: symbol_info
description: Get detailed metadata about the current symbol (name, exchange, type, description)

name: symbol_search
description: Search for symbols by name or keyword

name: pine_get_source
description: Get current Pine Script source code from the editor

name: pine_set_source
description: Set Pine Script source code in the editor

source.description: Pine Script source code to inject

name: pine_compile
description: Compile / add the current Pine Script to the chart

name: pine_get_errors
description: Get Pine Script compilation errors from Monaco markers

name: pine_save
description: Save the current Pine Script (Ctrl+S)

name: pine_get_console
description: Read Pine Script console/log output (compile messages, log.info(), errors)

name: pine_smart_compile
description: Intelligent compile: detects button, compiles, checks errors, reports study changes

name: pine_new
description: Create a new blank Pine Script

name: pine_open
description: Open a saved Pine Script by name

name.description: Name of the saved script to open (case-insensitive match)

name: pine_list_scripts
description: List saved Pine Scripts

name: pine_analyze
description: Run static analysis on Pine Script code WITHOUT compiling — catches array out-of-bounds, unguarded array.first()/last(), bad loop bounds, and implicit bool casts. Works offline, no TradingView connection needed.

source.description: Pine Script source code to analyze

name: pine_check
description: Compile Pine Script via TradingView's server API without needing the chart open. Returns compilation errors/warnings. Useful for validating code before injecting into the chart.

source.description: Pine Script source code to compile/validate

name: data_get_ohlcv
description: Get OHLCV bar data from the chart. Use summary=true for compact stats instead of all bars (saves context).

count.description: Number of bars to retrieve (max 500, default 100)

summary.description: Return summary stats (high, low, open, close, avg volume, range) instead of all bars — much smaller output

name: data_get_indicator
description: Get indicator/study info and input values

name: data_get_strategy_results
description: Get strategy performance metrics from Strategy Tester. Auto-opens the panel and auto-unhides a hidden strategy (TradingView never computes reports for hidden strategies); result includes unhidden_strategies when that happened.

name: data_get_trades
description: Get trade list from Strategy Tester. Auto-opens the panel and auto-unhides a hidden strategy.

name: data_get_equity
description: Get equity curve data from Strategy Tester

name: quote_get
description: Get real-time quote data for a symbol (price, OHLC, volume). If symbol is provided and differs from the current chart, the chart is briefly switched to fetch the quote and then restored — adds ~1-2s and serializes parallel calls.

symbol.description: Symbol to quote (blank = current chart symbol). Non-blank values cause a chart switch + restore.

name: depth_get
description: Get order book / DOM (Depth of Market) data from the chart

name: data_get_pine_lines
description: Read horizontal price levels drawn by Pine Script indicators (line.new). Returns deduplicated price levels per study. Use study_filter to target a specific indicator.

study_filter.description: Substring to match study name (e.g., "Profiler", "NY Levels"). Omit for all.

verbose.description: Return raw line data with IDs, coordinates, colors (default false — returns only unique price levels)

name: data_get_pine_labels
description: Read text labels drawn by Pine Script indicators (label.new). Returns text and price pairs. Use study_filter to target a specific indicator.

study_filter.description: Substring to match study name. Omit for all.

max_labels.description: Max labels per study (default 50). Set higher if you need all.

verbose.description: Return raw label data with IDs, colors, positions (default false — returns only text + price)

name: data_get_pine_tables
description: Read table data drawn by Pine Script indicators (table.new). Returns formatted text rows per table. Use study_filter to target a specific indicator.

study_filter.description: Substring to match study name. Omit for all.

name: data_get_pine_boxes
description: Read box/zone boundaries drawn by Pine Script indicators (box.new). Returns deduplicated {high, low} price zones. Use study_filter to target a specific indicator.

study_filter.description: Substring to match study name. Omit for all.

verbose.description: Return all boxes with IDs and coordinates (default false — returns unique price zones)

name: data_get_study_values
description: Get current indicator values from the data window for all visible studies (RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, EMAs, custom indicators with plot()).

name: capture_screenshot
description: Take a screenshot of the TradingView chart

region.description: Region to capture: full, chart, strategy_tester (default full)

method.description: Capture method: cdp (Page.captureScreenshot) or api (chartWidgetCollection.takeScreenshot) (default cdp)

wait_for_render.description: Wait for the chart canvas to stabilize before capturing. Use after chart_set_symbol or chart_set_timeframe to avoid stale frames.

name: indicator_set_inputs
description: Change indicator/study input values (e.g., length, source, period)

entity_id.description: Entity ID of the study (from chart_get_state)

inputs.description: JSON string of input overrides, e.g. '{"length": 50, "source": "close"}'. Keys are input IDs, values are the new values.

name: indicator_toggle_visibility
description: Show or hide an indicator/study on the chart

entity_id.description: Entity ID of the study (from chart_get_state)

visible.description: true to show, false to hide

name: indicator_search
description: Search TradingView's Indicators dialog for indicators, strategies, and community/public scripts by keyword. Returns matching titles grouped by section (Technicals, Community, My scripts, etc.).

name: indicator_add
description: Search the Indicators dialog and add a result to the chart by name. Works for strategies and community scripts, not just built-ins. Returns the new study entity_id.

query.description: Search keyword to find the indicator/strategy

match.description: Exact title to add (default: the query). Case-insensitive; falls back to first title containing it.

section.description: Restrict to a section: "Technicals", "Community", "My scripts", etc.

name: tab_list
description: List all open TradingView chart tabs

name: tab_new
description: Open a new chart tab. Optionally pick what to load in it: layout "new" creates a named blank layout, or pass a saved layout name to open it.

layout.description: "new" for a blank new layout, or a saved layout name (substring match). Omit to leave the tab on the layout picker.

name.description: Name for the new layout (used with layout: "new"; default "New layout")

name: layout_new
description: Create a new named blank chart layout (opens in a new tab)

name: tab_switch
description: Switch to a chart tab by index

name: layout_list
description: List saved chart layouts

name: layout_switch
description: Switch to a saved chart layout by name or ID

name.description: Name or ID of the layout to switch to

name: ui_find_element
description: Find UI elements by text, aria-label, or CSS selector and return their positions

query.description: Text content, aria-label value, or CSS selector to search for

name: watchlist_get
description: Get all symbols from the current TradingView watchlist with last price, change, and change%

name: watchlist_add
description: Add a symbol to the TradingView watchlist

symbol.description: Symbol to add (e.g., AAPL, BTCUSD, ES1!, NYMEX:CL1!)

name: watchlist_add_bulk
description: Add multiple symbols to the TradingView watchlist

name: watchlist_remove
description: Remove one or more symbols from the active TradingView watchlist

symbols.description: Symbols to remove — bare (AAPL) or full (NASDAQ:AAPL)

name: pane_list
description: List all chart panes in the current layout with their symbols and active state

name: pane_set_layout
description: Change the chart grid layout (e.g., single, 2x2, 2h, 3v)

layout.description: Layout code: s (single), 2h, 2v, 2-1, 1-2, 3h, 3v, 4 (2x2), 6, 8. Also accepts: single, 2x1, 1x2, 2x2, quad

name: pane_focus
description: Focus a specific chart pane by index (0-based)

name: pane_set_symbol
description: Set the symbol on a specific pane by index

symbol.description: Symbol to set (e.g., NQ1!, ES1!, AAPL)

name: tv_health_check
description: Read-only check of the local TradingView chart connection; no update check or app restart.

name: pine_editor_open
description: Open the Pine editor only; no trading or broker panel access.
